title: On the Spectral Synthesis of Lipschitz Vectorizations of Persistence Diagrams
summary: Persistence diagrams are fundamental descriptors in topological data analysis. Many statistical and machine learning methods require persistence diagrams to be mapped into vector spaces or compared through kernels. Although many persistence diagram vectorizations and persistence kernels have been proposed, there is no general framework for determining which persistence diagram vectorizations are synthesizable.
